title: Surreal Cosmic Journey
description: A winding cracked road stretches through an orange mountain landscape under a giant red sun. Translucent bubbles containing human figures in meditative poses float above the road, set against a swirling galaxy and cosmic sky.
prompt: Surreal fantasy landscape with a cracked winding road leading through orange mountains toward a massive glowing red sun. Translucent floating bubbles of various sizes contain people in lotus meditation pose, drifting above the asphalt. A vibrant cosmic sky filled with spiral galaxies, nebulae, and ethereal cloud formations in purple and gold tones. Dreamlike and mystical atmosphere with dramatic god rays.
